visualCharacteristics.layout: Single horizontal line, left-aligned with the content well, above the page H1
visualCharacteristics.typography: Small (about 12px) dark grey/black sans-serif; ancestor links unstyled until hover
visualCharacteristics.separator: Thin slash or chevron between items
visualCharacteristics.currentItem: Not linked; same or slightly lighter colour
visualCharacteristics.spacing: Tight vertical padding, small gap before the page H1

contentPattern: 1 column, 1 content row. The single cell holds an ordered list (or a line of links) of trail items in hierarchy order: every ancestor is a link, and the last item is the current page as plain text (not linked).

usage.description: Use at the top of a page, above the H1, to show the page's position in the site hierarchy (for example Home / Recipes).

reuseGuidance: Reuse on any page that needs a hierarchy trail. Author ancestors as links and the current page as plain text; separators are added by the block.
